title: My biography

fn.en: Say where you were, when you were there and how it was.

useful: It was great. / It was terrible.

sub.en: Look at the examples. Which word goes with I, he, she and it?

items.why: I / he / she / it → was.  You / we / they → were.

items.from: It was easy for them to practise.
items.a: It wasn’t easy for them to practise

items.from: There were bobsleighs for the team.
items.a: There weren’t any bobsleighs for the team

lines: I [was|were|am] born in Karaganda and I [grew|grow|was grow] up there.
My parents [weren’t|wasn’t|aren’t] rich, but we [were|was|are] very happy.
I [was|were|am] at university in Almaty from 2014 to 2018.
My first job [was|were|is] in a small company. It [wasn’t|weren’t|isn’t] easy, but it [was|were|is] interesting.
[Were|Was|Are] you at university too? — No, I [wasn’t|weren’t|am not].

tts: People were surprised to see a bobsleigh team from Jamaica at the 1988 Winter Olympics in Canada. It wasn’t very easy for the team to practise in Jamaica before the Olympics, because there was no ice and there were no bobsleighs for them to use. They weren’t successful in their races, but they were very popular with the people watching, because they tried so hard. There was a film about their story in 1993. It was a huge success.

items.s: The bobsleigh team was from Jamaica.
It was easy for the team to practise at home.
There were no bobsleighs in Jamaica.
They were successful in their races.
They were popular with the people watching.

tts: Was there a bobsleigh team at the Olympics? Yes, there was.
Was it easy for them to practise? No, it wasn’t.
Were there bobsleighs for them to use? No, there weren’t.
Were they popular? Yes, they were.

tts: I’m Dana. I was born in Karaganda in 1996 and I grew up there. My first job was in a shop. It was terrible, but the people were nice.
I’m Marat. I was born in Almaty, but my home town is Taraz — my parents were teachers there. I was at university in Astana from 2012 to 2016.
I’m Aigul. I wasn’t born in Kazakhstan. I was born in Turkey and we moved here when I was a child. My first holiday abroad was in 2019. It was great.

use: It was great. / It was terrible.

write.q: Write your short biography: 5 sentences. Where you were born, where you grew up, your school and university, and your first job. Say how one of them was.
write.model: I was born in Karaganda in 1996 and I grew up there. My school was very big — there were forty children in my class. I was at university in Almaty from 2014 to 2018. My first job was in a small company. It wasn’t easy, but the people were great.

speak.q: Answer out loud: Where were you born? Where did you grow up? Were you a happy child? How was your first job?
speak.model: I was born in Karaganda and I grew up there. Yes, I was — my family wasn’t rich, but we were very happy. My first job was terrible, but I learned a lot.
